prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1487; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the upper radiator support has been pushed rearward, with the hood latch assembly bent and both headlamp brackets broken. Most of this damage lines up with the frontal impact as described. Structural measurements taken at the shop match the repair plan, which calls for replacing the bumper cover, radiator support, hood latch, and both headlamp assemblies, followed by a wheel alignment and a check of the cooling system. The labor hours allotted for each step fit the extent of the damage. The invoices submitted show no repeated charges for the same work. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known from the records reviewed.
